actionResult.summary: Review 182 propose：G1 总体 thin single-boundary CLI 设计、跨 Delivery genericity、real archive/E2E 与 performance observation 边界成立；但 verify 读取正式 Verification 时冻结了硬编码 openspec/changes/<changeId>/verification.md 路径，绕过已存在的 OpenSpec/FormalFact structured path projection，形成第二套 OpenSpec path rule authority。

reviewFindings.title: verify MUST consume the existing structured Verification/OpenSpec projection instead of reconstructing the Change path
reviewFindings.problem: Design Decision 5 freezes flowkit verify to load openspec/changes/<changeId>/verification.md directly. Current FormalFactReader already derives the active Change verification artifact path from OpenSpec structured status/changeRootLogical and exposes the formal Change Verification status. Direct path reconstruction in the new CLI would create a second OpenSpec path rule authority and risks future path/projection drift.
reviewFindings.contractRef: C1 OpenSpec 1.7 thin integration / E2 current-Change OpenSpec projection / one fact one authority
reviewFindings.invariant: OpenSpec owns Change artifact/path semantics; Flowkit consumers must consume the existing structured/formal projection and must not independently reconstruct canonical OpenSpec paths.
evidence: 182 design.md Decision 5 states the CLI identifies the active Change and reads canonical openspec/changes/<changeId>/verification.md directly.
Current src/facts/formal-fact-reader.ts readOpenSpecArtifacts derives change-verification from OpenSpec status.changeRootLogical and projects that artifact path/status into FormalFactSnapshot.

02 v4 C1 requires structured outputs/path context to remain OpenSpec authority and E2 requires current Change OpenSpec projection to derive from formal changeId/OpenSpec structured projection rather than hardcoded paths.
reviewFindings.impact: Apply would freeze a CLI-specific path reconstruction/parser boundary that can diverge from the existing OpenSpec/FormalFact projection; correcting it later may require Proposal/scope reset instead of a local implementation fix.
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: Revise the verify design/spec/tasks so the command consumes the existing formal/structured Change Verification artifact projection (or another existing authority-safe projection) for path/status discovery. It may read the authority file through that projected logical path, but MUST NOT reconstruct openspec/changes/<changeId>/verification.md as a separate rule. Keep Verification execution/publication read-only semantics unchanged.
acceptance: No G1 design/spec requirement instructs the CLI to construct the verification.md path from openspec/changes/<changeId>.
verify discovers the current verification artifact/status from the existing FormalFact/OpenSpec structured projection and fails closed on missing/conflicting projection.
If selectionFingerprint/logical check ids are exposed, they are read from the authoritative publication without creating a second durable truth or changing Apply/revise-apply Verification authority.
No 03 Agent Adapter/Delivery behavior scope is introduced and the approved Apply mutation surface remains sufficient, or any genuinely required scope expansion is explicitly frozen before Apply.
